notFound.title: This link doesn't work
notFound.body: It may have been mistyped, or it may have been replaced by a newer one. Check the email you received, or reply to it to ask for a new link.

expired.title: This interview has closed
expired.body: The deadline for this role has passed. If you think that's a mistake, reply to the email that invited you.

closed.title: This interview isn't open
closed.body: The role is no longer accepting interviews. If you were expecting to record one, reply to the email that invited you.

cancelled.title: This interview was cancelled
cancelled.body: Nothing you recorded was lost, but this link no longer works. Reply to the email that invited you if you have questions.

completed.title: You've already completed this interview
completed.body: Thank you — there is nothing more to do. Your answers have been sent, and the team will contact you directly.

welcome.invitedBy: {{org}} has invited you to record a short interview for the {{jobTitle}} role.
welcome.invitedByNoRole: {{org}} has invited you to record a short interview.

steps.questions: {{count}} question, asked on camera by the team
steps.questions_other: {{count}} questions, asked on camera by the team
steps.record: You record your answer to each one, in your own time
steps.alone: No one is waiting — you choose when to start

needs.quiet: A few quiet minutes somewhere you can speak out loud
needs.browser: This page, open until you've finished

welcome.detailsHint: Only what {{org}} asked for. Everything here is optional unless marked.

fields.name: Name
fields.uploadHint: PDF or Word, up to 10 MB

welcome.resumeHint: You stopped at question {{index}}. Your earlier answers are saved.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.body: This interview is recorded. Here is exactly what that means.

points.recording: Your camera and microphone record your answers, question by question.
points.who: {{org}} can watch your recordings and read an automatic transcript of them.
points.ai: An automated analysis summarises your answers against the criteria for this role. It assists the decision — a person makes it.
points.retention: Your recordings are kept for the time {{org}} needs to decide, and then deleted. You can ask for them to be deleted at any time from your data page.

consent.accept: I understand and agree to be recorded
consent.acceptHint: You must agree to continue. If you would rather not, simply close this page and reply to the email that invited you.

device.title: Let's check your camera and microphone
device.subtitle: Nothing here is recorded or saved. This is just to make sure everything works before you start.
device.speakPrompt: Say something out loud — the bar should move
device.micGood: Your microphone is picking you up
device.micQuiet: We can barely hear you. Try speaking up, moving closer, or choosing another microphone.
device.permissionDenied: Camera or microphone access was refused. Allow it in your browser's address bar, then reload this page.
device.permissionHelp: Look for the camera icon in your browser's address bar.
device.noDevices: No camera or microphone was found. Plug one in, then reload this page.
device.busy: Your camera or microphone is being used by another app, such as a video call. Close it, then try again.
device.unsupported: This browser can't record video interviews. Please open this link in the latest Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge — on a computer if you can.
device.inAppBrowser: You seem to be in an in-app browser. Recording often fails here. Open this link in Safari or Chrome instead.

run.audioOnly: Audio only — your camera isn't available, so this interview records your voice. That is enough to take part.
run.timeUp: Time is up for this question — your answer was saved.
run.interrupted: Your last answer stopped when you left the page or a device was disconnected. What you had said was saved.
run.videoLost: Your last answer was saved, but its video didn't get through — only the sound did.

sendFailed.title: Your last answer didn't save
sendFailed.body: Nothing has been lost yet, but we couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

recordingLost.title: Your answer couldn't be recorded
recordingLost.body: Nothing reached the recorder, so there is nothing to send. Record this answer again.

run.networkPoor: Your connection looks unstable. Recording still works — saving may just take longer.
run.offline: You're offline. Your answer will be sent as soon as you're back.

review.title: Before you finish
review.question: Question {{index}}
review.next: When you finish, your interview is sent and your answers can no longer be changed.

run.leaveWarning: Your answer is still being saved. Leave now and it will be lost.

crash.title: Something went wrong on this page
crash.body: Your saved answers are safe. Reload to pick up where you left off.

done.title: That's it — thank you
done.body: Your interview has been sent to {{org}}. There is nothing more for you to do.

nextSteps.contact: They will contact you directly, at {{email}}.
nextSteps.noReply: This address doesn't accept replies — reply to the email that invited you instead.

done.privacy: See what data is kept, and delete it

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.subtitle: What {{org}} holds about this interview, and how to remove it.

items.identity: Your name and email, as {{org}} entered them when inviting you.
items.transcript: An automatic transcript of what you said.
items.analysis: An automated analysis of your answers against this role's criteria.
items.documents: Any CV or cover letter you uploaded.

privacy.rightsBody: You can ask for all of it to be deleted, at any time, without giving a reason. Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone — including for {{org}}, who will no longer be able to consider your application for this role.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete your interview?
deleteConfirm.body: Your recordings, transcript, analysis and uploaded documents will be permanently deleted. {{org}} will no longer be able to consider this application. This cannot be undone.

deleted.title: Your data has been deleted
deleted.body: Nothing from this interview is held any more. You can close this page.

errors.invalid_phone: That phone number is too long.
errors.invalid_linkedin: Enter a full address starting with https://
errors.not_requested: This role didn't ask for that.
errors.unsupported_document_type: Please upload a PDF or a Word document.
errors.document_too_large: That file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.key_mismatch: The upload didn't complete properly. Please try again.
errors.consent_required: You need to agree to be recorded before starting.
errors.rate_limited: That was a lot of requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
